design: All eight R141 full-update selected candidates; paired MUSCLE loss and extra cross-entropy training
source: Echterhoff et al., Findings EMNLP 2024, Eq. 1 and sections 4.1, 5.3
training: one epoch on original update_train plus first 40 source_train rows; no new labels
lora: original rank 8 q_proj/v_proj adapters initialized from selected candidate; both teachers frozen
loss: token mask student argmax != ground truth; KL(old||student) for errors else KL(new||student); temperature 1; target tokens including EOS; no auxiliary CE
optimizer: AdamW learning rate 0.0002; accumulation 8; clip norm 1; paired seed/order; final epoch checkpoint only
comparison_limit: Published loss under R141 resource settings, not original MUSCLE hyperparameters or numerical benchmark reproduction; extra CE controls optimizer updates but not teacher forward cost
evaluation: joint reevaluation of all fresh_old rows, cap_validation and cap_audit under same checker and generation; existing audit reused; no prospective generalization claim
failure_rule: retain failure; no hyperparameter selection on outcomes
